title: review: S0a: dispatch-skip telemetry — runs/sched/dispatch.jsonl rows with a reason per considered task, pipeline.first_ready_at stamp, schedlog helper
spec:
Goal T-0503, brief .orchestrator/adaptive-parallelism-program.md section P0 ("record why a ready task was not dispatched"). Base goal/T-0503. Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only.
Verified facts: daemon.dispatch (orchestrator/daemon.py:591-689) walks bus.read(status="queued", role="execute") plus budget-held retries in id order; skips stale(t) or not bus.ready(t); below SPEC_REVIEW_MIN or verdict approve it dispatches while free_slots (daemon.py:449-464) remain and `break`s at slots <= 0; verdict request_changes holds; otherwise it creates a spec review. Nothing records why a ready task waited. gotchas.md 2026-09-18: the break also skips spec-review creation for later tasks (documented fix candidate).
1. New orchestrator/schedlog.py: SCHED_DIR = STATE / "runs" / "sched"; append(name, row) writes one JSON line to SCHED_DIR/<name>.jsonl (mkdir parents, ts added when absent); read(name) returns the list of dict rows, skipping blank or malformed lines and counting them (return (rows, malformed) or expose read_with_malformed); never raises on a missing file (empty list).
2. daemon.dispatch: stamp pipeline.first_ready_at = time.time() once (never overwrite) the first time bus.ready(t) holds for a queued execute task, before any slot check. Build one row per tick and append it as "dispatch" only when at least one queued or budget-held execute task was considered: {"ts", "free_slots", "fallback", "running_execute", "running_claude", "considered": [{"task", "goal_id" (parent), "ready", "action": dispatched|spec_review|skipped, "reason", "executor" (when known)}]}. Reasons: stale -> "stale"; not ready -> "dependency"; fallback with no Claude tier -> "fallback_no_tier"; no slot -> "cooldown" when every enabled execute executor is cooling and not fallback, "account_capacity" when fallback and the Claude ceiling is used up, else "executor_capacity"; verdict request_changes -> "spec_review_changes"; spec review created or already pending -> "spec_review_pending"; budget-held retry that is not dispatched -> "budget"; stamp() no-op -> "other". A dispatched task has action dispatched and no reason.
3. Replace the `break` at slots <= 0 with a slots_exhausted flag: tasks after exhaustion are recorded skipped with the capacity reason and are NOT dispatched, but the spec-review branch still runs for later tasks that need one (the gotchas.md fix). No other change to which tasks dispatch or in which order; the second loop (review respawn) is untouched.
4. Tests: tests/test_schedlog.py test_append_and_read_tolerates_malformed_lines, test_read_missing_file_is_empty; tests/test_daemon.py test_dispatch_stamps_first_ready_at_once, test_dispatch_logs_skip_reasons_capacity_and_dependency, test_dispatch_log_row_absent_on_idle_tick, test_dispatch_creates_spec_reviews_after_slots_exhausted. Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: runs/sched/dispatch.jsonl gains one row per daemon tick that considered a queued or budget-held execute task, with a considered entry per task carrying action and reason exactly as named in the spec; idle ticks write no row
pipeline.first_ready_at is stamped once when a queued execute task first becomes ready and is never overwritten
the set and order of tasks dispatched per tick is unchanged, except that spec reviews are now created for ready tasks behind the exhausted-slots point

tests test_append_and_read_tolerates_malformed_lines, test_read_missing_file_is_empty, test_dispatch_stamps_first_ready_at_once, test_dispatch_logs_skip_reasons_capacity_and_dependency, test_dispatch_log_row_absent_on_idle_tick, test_dispatch_creates_spec_reviews_after_slots_exhausted pass and the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0
